deviations.description: Plan's Premise Re-Validation table cites 'the union-merge write sites at the no-op write site line ~1112 and the real-write site line ~1171' as evidence for idempotence coverage.
deviations.reason: Re-measured: line 1112 is confirmed as the no-op dependencies[] union-merge write (`.dependencies |= ((. // []) + $dep | unique)`). Line 1171, however, is the FILE_SCOPE_ADD union-merge inside the real (non-no-op) write path, not a dependencies[] merge. There is no second dependencies[] merge site at a real-write path, because the status-no-op restriction (line ~641-648) makes a real-transition + --depends-on-add call a hard validation error before the write function is ever reached -- so --depends-on-add's union-merge is reachable ONLY via the no-op branch at line 1112. This is a citation imprecision in the plan's background confirmation table, not a defect in the script and not a blocker for Phase 2 (Phase 2's own task list and verification criteria do not depend on a second dependencies[] write site existing).
deviations.annotation: *(deviation: altered -- line ~1171 is a FILE_SCOPE_ADD merge in the real-write path, not a second dependencies[] merge site; the dependencies[] union-merge exists only at the no-op site, line 1112, which is the only site --depends-on-add can ever reach)*

Call with the task's own current status (e.g. 'postflight $task_number research <session_id>' if the task is already 'researched') to add the edge without also performing a status transition.
